Hosted payload rideshare mission. Fly OMS’s miniaturized passive microwave sensors and propulsion system demonstrator from Exotrail?
Description

Hosted payload rideshare mission. Fly one of OMS’s miniaturized passive microwave sensors. Hall-Effect propulsion system demonstrator from Exotrail? The software developed by Exotrail (ExoOPS™) for mission design and operation will serve as a key propulsion ground segment element for the mission.
